results.title: Invalid investigation id shows "Investigation not found" with a working link back
Ids with special characters (%00, <script>, very long, ../) do not crash the page
Unknown route /nope and /app/investigations/ return a 404 page
Unknown #hash falls back to the Problem step
Deep links #report and #cause open those steps
Browser back/forward: dashboard -> workspace -> steps -> back returns to dashboard, forward returns to workspace
Back to the dashboard after editing shows the edited title
Double-clicking "New investigation" creates exactly one investigation
Human-speed double click (2 clicks 120 ms apart) on "New investigation" creates exactly one
Changing only the #hash in the address bar of an open investigation switches the step
Double-clicking "Start a new investigation" on the landing page creates exactly one
Double-clicking Duplicate creates exactly one copy
Pressing "New investigation" then browser Back immediately leaves no half-created junk beyond one blank
Invalid id, unknown routes, back/forward, double-click create

notes.text: Step changes use history.replaceState, so Back leaves the investigation instead of going to the previous step; after Forward the step shown is Report
Blank "Untitled investigation" rows remain if user creates and abandons: 5
